description: Purpose: China-EU carbon footprint crosswalk - for a given product, shows what China's product carbon footprint certification (17 products, SAMR/CNCA) requires, what the EU CBAM/CSRD/ESPR requires, whether the two overlap, what data can be shared, and what is still officially unanswered. Guidelines: call this whenever a question involves exporting to the EU, dual compliance, 'does China's carbon footprint certification get recognized by the EU', or comparing Chinese vs EU carbon requirements. Modes: mode=lookup (default, needs product=), mode=gaps (the honest gap list - what we searched and did NOT find), mode=overview (counts + core conclusions). Limits: the CN/EU factual statements are grade A (official documents); the crosswalk itself is Trustbase Lab's judgment (grade B), NOT an official mapping. There is no official China-EU data mutual-recognition document as of 2026-10-26. Pair with get_carbon_standards / query_cbam_emission_factors for the underlying standards and factors. Ex: get_cn_eu_mapping(product='轮胎'), get_cn_eu_mapping(mode='gaps'), get_cn_eu_mapping(mode='overview', response_format='json')

mode.description: lookup=按产品查；overview=总览；gaps=缺口清单（最诚实、最有价值）

product.description: 产品名或关键词（中文或英文）。如：轮胎、钢铁、电解铝、水泥、锂离子电池。

name: get_cn_eu_mapping

text.description: Human-readable result (markdown, or a JSON string when response_format=json).
